description: An order's earlier invoices (SPEC.md §21), from the sale's records as they open, read on every relay of a list of `relays`. `declarations`: the sale's declarations, each with its invoice (`invoice`, here a stand-in for its BOLT11 string), its `paymentHash`, `createdAt` and `expiresAt` (its BOLT11 timestamp, and timestamp + expiry), `declaredAt` (its event's created_at) and `rest` true for a declaration with `rest` (absent: none). `records`: the sale's records at the registry addresses of deposit addresses, each a lease (its JSON's `address`, `createdAt`, `expiresAt`, `invoice`, the declared invoice it names in any ASCII case or null for an order paid on-chain only, and `confirmed`, absent when the JSON has none: not confirmed), a withdrawal (`withdrawn` true) or a record of a newer format (`newer` true), at the registry address of `address`, each with its event's `createdAt` and `id`. Every record and declaration has `sentBy`, how many relays of the list sent it (absent: all of them); a case's `relays`, when given, is its list's length instead. `expected.invoices`: the DeclaredInvoices in their order, each its `paymentHash` (null for one a lease gives), `onchainAddress`, `createdAt` and `declaredAt`. Step 1 of the check at `now`: `expected.mayBePaid`, the invoices (indices in `expected.invoices`) that may still be paid; `expected.checked`, those whose payment step 1 checks: every one that may still be paid, even alone; `statuses`, the result of each invoice's payment check should step 1 check it (its `state`, with `received` when above 0, or an error; absent: it checks none); `expected.outcome`: null when none may still be paid (step 2 follows), else the invoice handed out (`handOut`, with `invoice_pending`), `orderPaid` (the invoice `order_paid` carries) or the error. `readFails`: fewer than a majority of the relays answer the sale's records read again in step 1 (absent: a majority answers); a paid invoice, then an error of a payment check, decide before it.

cases.name: a declaration and its marked lease: its address
a declaration and its lease as first published, not confirmed: no address
a declaration and a lease without confirmed, which is not confirmed: no address
a lease naming its invoice in upper case: its address (ASCII case ignored)
the lease's mark, newer, replaces the lease as first published: its address
the lease withdrawn: no address
a withdrawal older than the lease replaces nothing: its address
a withdrawal and the mark in one second, the withdrawal's id the lower: no address
a withdrawal and the mark in one second, the mark's id the lower: its address
a record of a newer format, the newest at its address: no lease there
a record of a newer format older than the lease: its address
an order paid on-chain only, its lease marked: one invoice, declared at its mark's date
an order paid on-chain only, its lease not confirmed: no invoice
an order paid on-chain only, its lease without confirmed: no invoice
a lease naming an invoice that has no declaration: left out
a declaration of a rest invoice: no invoice of the order
a try withdrawn on one address, the next one marked: the next one's address
a try whose withdrawal was not read, the next one marked: the next one's address
two confirmed leases name one invoice: the newest event gives its address
two confirmed leases name one invoice in one second: the lowest id gives its address
sorted by createdAt, then payment hash (none first), then address
at expiresAt + 119: it may still be paid, handed out
one may still be paid, and it was: order_paid, never handed out again
one may still be paid, its payment being confirmed on-chain: handed out
one may still be paid, its check fails: its error (it may have been paid)
at expiresAt + 120: none may still be paid (step 2)
an invoice past its end and a later one: the later checked, then handed out
two may still be paid, the newer's declaration on a majority, the older's on one relay: the newer
two may still be paid, the older's declaration on a majority, the newer's on one relay: the older
two may still be paid, the older paid: order_paid
two may still be paid, both paid: order_paid, the first
two may still be paid, the older's check fails, the newer paid: order_paid
two may still be paid, one check fails, none paid: its error, whatever the relays sent
two may still be paid, the older paid, fewer than a majority answer the read again: order_paid all the same
two may still be paid, both open, fewer than a majority answer the read again: network
two may still be paid, one check fails, fewer than a majority answer the read again: the check's error
of 3 relays, 2 are a majority: the older, which 2 sent, the newer 1
of 4 relays, 2 are no majority: the older, which 3 sent, the newer 2
of 4 relays, 2 each: no one decides, the newest
two may still be paid, both on a majority (no one decides), both open: the newest
two may still be paid, neither on a majority (a relay mute), both open: the newest
no one decides, the older unconfirmed, the newer open: the older
no one decides, the older open with something received, the newer open: the older
three may still be paid, no one decides, two unconfirmed: the newest unconfirmed
a failed call's mark on one relay, then an invoice shown and paid: order_paid, the one shown
a failed call's mark on one relay, then an invoice shown, not paid yet: the one shown
the same, both of one second, the one never shown sorting last: the one shown
the same, the failed call's server's clock 3 s ahead: the one shown
